Apus Mini: less energy at the quad's 20.target: Wh/km at 20 m/s < half the quad's

Apus Mini: comparable manoeuvre.target: banked turn radius at 20 m/s ≤ the quad's at 45° bank (41 m)

Alcotan: faster sustained.target: sustained top speed (pack 30C, motors 22 A) ≥ 1.25 × the quad's

Alcotan: a chase at 40 m/s.target: endurance at 40 m/s ≥ the quad's at its top speed, with a turn

Gavilan: span for a hangar.target: span ≤ a fifth of a gate (0.30 m)

Gavilan: the quad's hover agility.target: pitch acceleration in the hover ≥ the quad's
